! AI Overview XHR
://www.google.com/async/folsrch?*$xhr
! AI Overview
google.com/search##div[data-cb-scope]
! AI Overview (uBOL for Safari)
google.com##:matches-path(/^\/search(?:\?|$)/) div[data-cb-scope]
